title: Treasury Admits Insolvency. Bitcoin Already Knew.
script_summary:
# ORACLE BRIEF

The US Treasury just admitted it's insolvent — $47 trillion gap between assets and liabilities. Bitcoin already priced that in.

Here's the signal architecture: MicroStrategy executed a billion-dollar Bitcoin acquisition in a single trading session — the largest one-day pull in the asset's history. That's not buying pressure, that's supply shock. Coins gone off-market don't return.
